50624487.summary_zh: 印度主要反對黨的青年翼因不滿 Instagram 帳號遭到封鎖，動員抗議者衝進 Meta 位於海得拉巴與孟買的辦公室。這起衝突凸顯出 Meta 在面對政府審查壓力和反對黨抗爭之間的艱難處境，最終促使 Meta 在抗議後恢復了部分帳號。／印度主要反對黨的青年翼因不滿 Instagram 帳號遭到封鎖，動員抗議者衝進 Meta 位於海得拉巴與孟買的辦公室。這起衝突凸顯出 Meta 在面對政府審查壓力和反對黨抗爭之間的艱難處境，最終促使 Meta 在抗議後恢復了部分帳號。
50624487.summary_en: Activists from India's main opposition youth wing stormed Meta's offices in Hyderabad and Mumbai after their Instagram accounts were blocked. This clash highlights Meta's difficult position between government censorship pressure and opposition protests, which ultimately led Meta to restore some accounts following the demonstrations.

50607512.title: Lowering Perplexity Without Scaling
50607512.title_zh: 在不擴規模的情況下降低困惑度
50607512.summary_zh: OpenAI 近期發表了一篇關於模型困惑度（perplexity）隨時間下降的部落格文章，引發外界對模型智慧程度提升的討論。然而分析指出，該圖表其實是基於對特定程式碼語料庫的預測，若訓練資料中程式碼的比例增加，就會直接影響困惑度的表現。因此，這類數據主要反映了訓練集組成的改變，而非模型在各方面能力的全面提升。／OpenAI 近期發表了一篇關於模型困惑度（perplexity）隨時間下降的部落格文章，引發外界對模型智慧程度提升的討論。然而分析指出，該圖表其實是基於對特定程式碼語料庫的預測，若訓練資料中程式碼的比例增加，就會直接影響困惑度的表現。因此，這類數據主要反映了訓練集組成的改變，而非模型在各方面能力的全面提升。
50607512.summary_en: OpenAI recently published a blog post showing a drop in model perplexity over time, sparking discussions on improving intelligence. However, analysis reveals that the chart is based on predictions of a fixed code corpus, and increasing the proportion of code in training data directly affects perplexity performance. Therefore, such metrics primarily reflect changes in training set composition rather than a universal enhancement of model capabilities.

50592307.title: Arctic: A Practical Lock-Free Adaptive Radix Tree
50592307.title_zh: Arctic：一個實用的無鎖定自適應基數樹
50592307.summary_zh: 現代系統生態系需要高效能的索引資料結構，但以往很難同時兼顧高效能、無鎖定（lock-free）與範圍掃描（range scan）。Arctic 是一個無鎖定自適應基數樹，透過精細的後設資料（metadata）配置與凍結式協調協議解決了此問題。將其整合進 RocksDB 與 Turso 後，在寫入密集型基準測試中，其吞吐量分別提升了最高 40% 與 12%。／現代系統生態系需要高效能的索引資料結構，但以往很難同時兼顧高效能、無鎖定（lock-free）與範圍掃描（range scan）。Arctic 是一個無鎖定自適應基數樹，透過精細的後設資料（metadata）配置與凍結式協調協議解決了此問題。將其整合進 RocksDB 與 Turso 後，在寫入密集型基準測試中，其吞吐量分別提升了最高 40% 與 12%。
50592307.summary_en: The modern systems ecosystem requires high-performance indexing data structures, yet previous indexes struggled to offer high performance, lock freedom, and range scans simultaneously. Arctic is a lock-free adaptive radix tree that solves this through a careful metadata layout and a freezing-based coordination protocol. Integrating it into RocksDB and Turso improved throughput by up to 40% and 12% on write-heavy benchmarks, respectively.

50624061.title: AMD EPYC Zen 6 vs. Zen 1 Performance: 12.1x Geo Mean in Less Than 10 Years
50624061.title_zh: AMD EPYC Zen 6 與 Zen 1 效能比較：不到十年內達到 12.1 倍幾何平均效能提升
50624061.summary_zh: 隨著 AMD EPYC 9006 系列伺服器處理器的推出，外媒評測將最新的 Zen 6 架構處理器與十年前的第一代 EPYC Zen 1 旗艦處理器進行了跨世代效能對比。測試結果顯示，在真實世界的工作負載下，新一代處理器取得了驚人的 12.1 倍幾何平均效能增長，在人工智慧（AI）任務中甚至高達 133 倍。／隨著 AMD EPYC 9006 系列伺服器處理器的推出，外媒評測將最新的 Zen 6 架構處理器與十年前的第一代 EPYC Zen 1 旗艦處理器進行了跨世代效能對比。測試結果顯示，在真實世界的工作負載下，新一代處理器取得了驚人的 12.1 倍幾何平均效能增長，在人工智慧（AI）任務中甚至高達 133 倍。
50624061.summary_en: Following the launch of AMD EPYC 9006 series server processors, benchmarks compared the latest Zen 6 architecture against the original EPYC Zen 1 flagship from a decade ago. The results show that under real-world workloads, the new generation achieves an astonishing 12.1x geometric mean performance increase, and up to 133x in artificial intelligence tasks.

50622804.title: Rune: Rust VM for Emacs
50622804.title_zh: Rune：基於 Rust 的 Emacs 虛擬機器
50622804.summary_zh: Rune 是一個以 Rust 語言從頭實作的實驗性 Emacs 核心專案，旨在將多執行緒（multi-threaded）的 Emacs Lisp 引入編輯器。該專案藉由 Rust 生態系來實現更快的垃圾回收（GC）、正規表示式與 JSON 處理，並期望在與現有 Emacs Lisp 套件相容的同時提升整體效能。／Rune 是一個以 Rust 語言從頭實作的實驗性 Emacs 核心專案，旨在將多執行緒（multi-threaded）的 Emacs Lisp 引入編輯器。該專案藉由 Rust 生態系來實現更快的垃圾回收（GC）、正規表示式與 JSON 處理，並期望在與現有 Emacs Lisp 套件相容的同時提升整體效能。
50622804.summary_en: Rune is an experimental Emacs core project written from scratch in Rust, aiming to introduce multi-threaded Emacs Lisp to the editor. The project leverages the Rust ecosystem to achieve faster garbage collection, regular expressions, and JSON processing, while striving to maintain bug-compatibility with existing Emacs Lisp packages for improved overall performance.

50624497.title: 2035 Came Early
50624497.summary_zh: 作者透過將 Linux 編譯為 WebAssembly 的全新引擎 unkernel，實現了在瀏覽器內極速執行完整 Linux 作業系統與圖形化介面。大型語言模型與高效能技術的結合，讓原本預期在 2035 年才能達到的技術願景提前實現。
50624497.summary_en: The author achieves lightning-fast execution of a complete Linux OS and graphical interface inside the browser using unkernel, a new engine that compiles Linux to WebAssembly. The combination of large language models and high-performance technologies has brought a technical vision originally expected for 2035 into reality early.

50593006.title: Ride the SQL curve from basics to mastery
50593006.title_zh: 從基礎到精通，輕鬆駕馭 SQL 學習曲線
50593006.summary_zh: 這是一個提供免費且免註冊的線上 SQL 互動式學習平台。內容涵蓋從基礎的 SELECT 與 JOIN 查詢，到進階的視窗函式（window function）與共用表格運算式（CTE），讓使用者能透過真實資料集直接在瀏覽器中練習。
50593006.summary_en: This is a free, no-signup online platform for interactive SQL learning. It covers everything from basic SELECT and JOIN queries to advanced window functions and common table expressions, allowing users to practice directly in the browser using real datasets.

50606611.title: Becoming a Magician
50606611.summary_zh: 作者在清理舊筆記時，意外發現自己十幾歲時寫下的理想生活藍圖在多年後幾乎全數實現。這段經歷讓她體悟到，當初的願景已成為當前生活的穩固基石，因此她需要描繪出一個目前看似不可能實現的新願景，並朝其邁進。
50606611.summary_en: While cleaning out old notes, the author unexpectedly discovered that an ideal life blueprint she wrote as a teenager had almost entirely come true years later. This experience made her realize that the original vision has become the solid baseline of her current life, so she needs to outline a new vision that currently seems impossible and orient herself toward it.

50625004.title: I'm not excited about tech anymore
50625004.title_zh: 我對科技不再感到興奮
50625004.summary_zh: 作者探討了自己對現代科技逐漸失去熱情的原因，並批評人工智慧、訂閱制、加密貨幣等趨勢往往只是製造垃圾、浪費資源且剝奪專業價值。相對地，他現在更熱衷於穩定、簡單、遵循開放協定且能確實解決問題的傳統工具與軟體。
50625004.summary_en: The author explores why he has gradually lost enthusiasm for modern tech, criticizing trends like AI, subscriptions, and crypto for creating junk, wasting resources, and devaluing professional fields. In contrast, he is now much more passionate about stable, simple, traditional tools and software that follow open protocols and genuinely solve problems.

50602041.title: Falsehoods Programmers Believe About ATProto
50602041.title_zh: 程式設計師對 ATProto 協定的常見迷思
50602041.summary_zh: 整理程式設計師在開發基於 AT 協定（ATProto）時常犯的迷思，強調使用者識別碼（handle）隨時可能變更或失效，不適合做為索引。資料庫（database）應以去中心化識別碼（DID）作為主鍵（primary key），並在寫入前進行正規化（normalize）處理。此外，系統不應使用快取（cache）的 handle 進行身分驗證與權限判斷，需定期更新對映資料。
50602041.summary_en: It outlines common misconceptions among programmers when developing with AT Protocol (ATProto), emphasizing that user handles can change or expire at any time and are unsuitable as index keys. Databases should use Decentralized Identifiers (DIDs) as primary keys and normalize them before storing. In addition, systems must not rely on cached handles for identity verification and access control, requiring periodic updates to handle mappings.

50625888.title: Jevons Paradox in AI: Cheaper Tokens Won't Pay for Capex
50625888.title_zh: 人工智慧領域的謝馮斯悖論：代幣降價無法彌補巨額資本支出
50625888.summary_zh: 分析指出人工智慧（AI）推理（inference）成本的下降並未能透過謝馮斯悖論（Jevons paradox）帶來超越降幅的代幣（token）用量成長，導致總營收難以填補雲端業者高達數千億美元的資本支出（capex）。研究顯示固定能力模型的價格年降數倍，但邊界模型（frontier model）的運行成本卻因規模擴大與推理時間變長而大幅上升。業者正試圖從按 token 計費轉向依結果計價（outcome pricing），企圖獲取原本用於支付人力成本的預算。
50625888.summary_en: The analysis points out that falling artificial intelligence (AI) inference costs have failed to trigger demand growth beyond price declines via the Jevons paradox, leaving total revenues insufficient to cover cloud providers' hundreds of billions in capital expenditures (capex). Research indicates that while the price of a fixed capability level drops several times per year, the cost of running frontier models continues to rise due to larger model sizes and longer reasoning times. Vendors are attempting to shift from token-based billing to outcome pricing in order to capture budgets historically allocated to labor costs.
